rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the opinion narrow and posture-bound (Rule 12 plausibility) while reaffirming Bantam Books’ functional, context-sensitive coercion test and preserving room for ordinary, viewpoint-neutral regulation. Thomas/Alito/Gorsuch are the most likely separate writers to emphasize broader anti-circumvention principles and skepticism of informal governmental pressure, while Kagan is the main alternative majority author if Roberts seeks a cross-ideological, administrable standard.
